title: Offline Random Sample
statement:
Move a random sample into the front of an array.

Contract
- `values` is non-null and contains distinct integers; `0 <= k <= values.length`.
- Use the supplied `Random`; do not create another source of randomness.
- Mutate `values` so the first `k` positions contain a uniformly random k-element subset. The order of those sampled values may be random.
- Preserve the multiset of all array values.

Examples
- Sampling `2` values from `[0, 1, 2, 3]` leaves two distinct original values in the first two positions.
- Sampling `0` values leaves the sampled prefix empty.
- Sampling all values leaves the whole array as a permutation of the input.

examples.output: any two distinct original values in the first two positions

hints: A full shuffle is more work than necessary when only the first k positions matter.
At step i, randomly choose one value from the unchosen suffix and swap it into position i.
Repeat the Fisher-Yates swap only for the first k positions. Intended complexity: O(n) time when k grows with n and O(1) extra space.
inputSyntax: Input: array values followed by sample size, for example: [0, 1, 2, 3] 2
